items.title: 14.6 Graphical representation of S.H.M (graph se dikhana) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.6 with Fig. 14.9 (PDF 31).

blocks.text: S.H.M karne wali body ke displacement, velocity aur acceleration ko waqt ke saath graph par Fig. 14.9 (a, b aur c) mein dikhaya gaya hai.
(i) S.H.M karne wale particle ka displacement:
Is se pata chalta hai ke extreme position par particle ka displacement sab se zyada (x₀) hota hai.

blocks.alt: Aik period mein displacement aur waqt ka graph, har chauthai period aur xo, -xo par dashed lines. Curve +xo se shuru, zero se guzar kar -xo tak aur wapas +xo tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.9 (a): S.H.M karti body ke displacement ki graph ki shakal (kitab ki Figure 14.9 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: (ii) S.H.M karne wale particle ki velocity ka magnitude (miqdar):

Direction (simt) ke saath velocity v = −x₀ω sin(ωt) hai, kyun ke +x₀ se chhori gayi body pehle O ki taraf, yani negative (manfi) direction mein chalta hai. Velocity mean position par sab se zyada (v = x₀ω) aur extreme positions par zero hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Aik period mein velocity ka graph, xo omega aur -xo omega ke darmiyan. Curve zero se shuru, chauthai period par -xo omega, aadhe par zero, teen chauthai par +xo omega aur phir zero.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.9 (b): S.H.M karti body ki velocity ki graph ki shakal (kitab ki Figure 14.9 (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ka velocity graph zero se pehle oopar jata hai, yani v = +x₀ω sin(ωt). Lekin jab body +x₀ se chhori jaye to woh O ki taraf, yani negative direction mein chalta hai, is liye sahi velocity v = −x₀ω sin(ωt) hai aur graph zero se pehle neeche jata hai; khaaka yahi dikhata hai. Teenon graph milayein: jahan displacement sab se zyada hai wahan velocity zero hai, aur acceleration hamesha displacement ke ulat hai.
(iii) S.H.M karne wale particle ka acceleration:
Is mein x = x₀ cos ωt rakhein:
Acceleration extreme positions par sab se zyada (x₀ω²) aur mean position par zero hota hai.

blocks.alt: Aik period mein acceleration ka graph, omega square xo aur minus omega square xo ke darmiyan. Curve sab se negative value se shuru, aadhe period par maximum, phir wapas: hamesha displacement ke ulat.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.9 (c): S.H.M karti body ke acceleration ki graph ki shakal (kitab ki Figure 14.9 (c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Equations (14.19), (14.20) aur (14.21) ke graphs (Fig. 14.9 a, b, c) se yeh result (nateeja) nikalta hai:

items: Velocity aur displacement ka phase difference π/2 (chauthai chakkar) hai.
Acceleration aur displacement ka phase difference π (aadha chakkar) hai: jab displacement +x₀ par sab se zyada hai to acceleration sab se zyada negative hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke acceleration aur displacement ka phase difference π/2 hai. a = −ω²x se saaf hai ke acceleration hamesha displacement ke bilkul ulat hai, is liye un ka phase difference π hai. Velocity in dono se π/2 alag hai. Kitab ka aakhri jumla ('displacement, velocity aur acceleration ka phase difference π/2 hai') bhi isi tarah samjhein: har agli quantity pichhli se π/2 aage hai (x se v, v se a).

blocks.prompt: S.H.M mein kis jagah (a) speed aur (b) acceleration sab se zyada hota hai?
blocks.explanation: (a) Speed mean position par sab se zyada, x₀ω, aur extreme par zero. (b) Acceleration extreme positions par sab se zyada, x₀ω², aur mean position par zero.

items: x = x₀cosωt; v = −x₀ω sinωt (magnitude x₀ω sinωt); a = −x₀ω² cosωt.
v aur x mein π/2 ka farq; a aur x mein π ka farq (bilkul ulat).
